paragraphs: Week 3 woke up and chose demolition. Slayday Barbie dropped a league-leading 168.84 points, collecting Winner of the Week and Steamroller honors in one very loud afternoon.
Shannon’s Serving Punt claimed the No. 1 spot with 139.98 points, while Pitts Out For the Boys settled into No. 2 after surviving the week’s Photo Finish with 117.08.
Milk These TDs poured up 114.86 points and a Giant Slayer badge on the way to No. 4. Apparently calcium builds strong bones and stronger upsets.

At the other end of the emotional spectrum, glizzie gambler scored 108.10 and still walked away with Hard-Luck Hero, while Girls Just Wanna Have TDs landed at No. 16 with 56.04 and the Basement Dweller badge.
Week 4, you have an impossible act to follow. Please bring points, plot twists, and exactly the right amount of chaos.
